title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general dexterity

evidence.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date.
Gemini Robotics 2.5 is rolling out to our robotics partners .
During a real-world proof-of-concept on Mercedes-Benz production lines, our models helped Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid pick and pack automotive parts with a 96% success rate.
We tested Gemini Robotics 2.5’s capabilities in task breadth, performance, and complexity across over 200 distinct tasks, though this approach could scale to many more.
To test jailbreak robustness, we are releasing ASIMOV-Jailbreak , a new open-source benchmark containing hundreds of prompts that disguise unsafe requests across dozens of scenes.
